title: Mayor Owens Announces Annual "Home For The Holidays" Tree Lighting
summary: Mayor Sharon F. Owens announced the 2026 'Home for the Holidays' Tree Lighting ceremony scheduled for November 27 at 6:00 p.m. in Clinton Square, featuring a new tradition called 'Together Under One Tree' to celebrate Syracuse's cultural diversity. The event includes performances, a youth art contest, ice rink opening, and accessible viewing areas, positioning the tree lighting as a community unity initiative under the new mayoral administration.
department_refs: Department of Parks, Recreation & Youth Programs

political_signal.description: Mayor Owens frames tree lighting as first administration event and explicitly establishes cultural inclusion and community unity as governing priorities through new 'Together Under One Tree' tradition.
